notes.title: Fix for cover image bug. Warning about internal achievement reset by update.
notes.content:
The cover image for "Avoiding Bad Money" was an image from "Blue Puppy Adventure," so we changed it to the correct cover image.

[h3] [Caution] Update will reset in-game achievements [/h3]
We have received reports that the previous in-game achievements display will be initialized when updating to Ver. 1.2.0.
This may be due to a change in the name of the game executable file.
(The blank spaces in the file name were removed.)
Achievements on Steam will remain, but if you have just started playing or are in the middle of earning achievements, please be careful and choose not to update.

[h3] For those aiming for trophy completion [/h3]
The trophy completion achievement, which is obtained when you have earned all achievements other than the trophy completion achievement, is not the achievements on Steam [b], but [/b], and refers to the "Acquired Achievements" on the title screen [b] in the game [/b]. When you have earned all the trophies, you will start to achieve trophy completion and it will be reflected in your Steam achievements.
Therefore, if the in-game achievements are initialized by the update while you are aiming for trophy completion, please re-earn your in-game achievements, including those already listed in the Steam achievements.
We apologize for the inconvenience, but thank you for your cooperation.

notes.title: September 17, 2024 Permanent price reduction & update to Ver. 1.2.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41690458/41c3ad278ed33567cc50c38ca86429c695e6348f.png[/img]
[h3]Permanent price reduction[/h3]
The price has been reduced from $9.99 to [b]$4.99[/b].
This is not a temporary discount, but a permanent $4.99 item.
It will be further discounted during sales.

[h3]Update[/h3]
Major changes in Ver. 1.2.0 are as follows
[list]
[*]Lighter in-game search engine
[*]Removed tips (because they are no longer needed to speed up scene loading).
[*]Increased the volume of background music and sound effects.
[*]Added endless references mode in English.
[*]Changed language to Japanese on first startup
[*]Changed the display method of 3D graphics to make them lighter & retouched to correct them
[*]Added publisher BOCSTE, Ltd. to logo and copyright notice
[*]Changed information about some of the fictional books.
[/list]

Although it looks much the same as before the update, the inner workings have changed significantly.
Faster scene loading for a more comfortable playing experience.
The deleted Tips may be published later on the official site outside the game in the form of a “Kakureza Tips Collection” or something similar.

The following is an update from  18 Sep.

[Caution] In-game achievements are reset by the update

It has been reported that the previous in-game achievements display is initialized when updating to Ver. 1.2.0.

This may be due to the change in the name of the game executable file.

(The blank spaces in the file name have been removed)

Achievements on Steam will remain, but if you have just started playing recently or are in the middle of earning achievements, please be careful and consider not updating.

For those aiming for trophy completion

The trophy completion achievement obtained when you have earned all achievements other than the game itself is not an achievement on Steam, but is reflected in Steam achievements when you start to achieve trophy completion when you have earned all of them by referring to the "Acquired Achievements" on the title screen in the game.

Therefore, if the in-game achievements are initialized by the update while you are aiming for trophy completion, please re-earn your in-game achievements, including those already listed in Steam achievements.

We apologize for the inconvenience, but thank you for your cooperation.

notes.title: 05/20/2023 Update "True end character feed manualization"
notes.content:
Made a small update.
The changes are as follows.

[h3] True end character feed manualization[/h3]
Since the text was displayed automatically, it was fast to read aloud, so it became possible to skip characters at any time. You can send text by touching anywhere on the screen.
When both the text and the end roll are finished, it will return to the start screen, but at that time, the screen transition may be delayed. After the second time, you can skip the end roll.

[h3] Changed "Saisoku" to "Tokusoku"[/h3] (Japanese version only)
I changed it because "dunning" seems to be more correct as a library term.

[h3] Changed dialogue around reservation[/h3]
Slightly changed the dialogue between the main character and the user when reserving or renting.

[h3] Changed message display time[/h3]
In two places, the display time of the message was short, so we extended the time.

notes.title: 08/21/2022 Update: Catalog maker, etc.
notes.content:
[h2] Main upload point [/h2]
・You can now play "Infinite Reference" (sorry, Japanese only) and "Book Catalog Maker" (Japanese/English) from the title menu.

[h3] Bibliographic Maker [/h3]
・This mode allows you to create an original catalog of books in the same format as the search machine used at the Kakureza  Library.
・You can play regardless of the clearing status of the main story.
・Use the keyboard to input and take screenshots.
・You can choose from 12 types of covers.
・If you take a picture with Steam's function ([F12] key by default), it will be saved in "Screenshot" on the top bar of Steam. If you shoot with the [Print Screen] key on your PC, create a new empty file with image editing software such as Photoshop, paste it, name it and save it in your favorite location such as local "Pictures".
・Since it is simply a function to shoot images, there is no actual search function or cataloging.

*Technical problem... Originally, only the preview area on the right side of the screen was cut out, the file name was automatically given (generated from the date and time), and the image was saved in png format in the automatically generated catalog folder. Building as a game didn't work.
* Due to the above problems, the screenshot range includes not only the preview area but also the input form and the cover candidate.

[h2] Other minor fixes [/h2]
・Fixed the problem that "the item disappears from the achievement list of the start menu when a certain achievement is achieved".
・Since there were two "Telecommunications" genres, they were merged into one.
・Although it is only the search machine in the title menu, the following functions have been modified in the search machine.
　　-Every time the search machine is closed, the scroll bar returns to the top and the open headings are closed.
　　-Automatically scrolls to the bottom when opening the bottom row of headings by author/publisher/genre.
・Fixed an issue where there was no hitbox on the manual paper and the click penetrated to the bottom.
・Solved the problem that an unnecessary sound effect sounded when switching languages after trying to initialize continuously.

notes.title: Update for January 25th
notes.content:
[h3] Day 18 Score Bug [/ h3]
Fixed a bug that if you load the beginning of the 18th day in the middle of the 18th day in the game, the evaluation points will not be returned and will be taken over as it is.

[h3] Precautions for updating [/ h3]
If you have already started Steam, you can update it by quitting Steam from the task manager and logging in again.
Even if the saves and achievement data inside the game are reset, the achievements on Steam will not disappear. However, the achievement of "completed achievements" is judged by whether or not all the achievements in the game have been acquired, so if you are aiming for completeness, please regain the achievements in the game.

[h3] Nickname credit [/ h3]
Thank you for reporting the bug. The name will be posted on the ending together with other reporters when there is a larger update later. Thank you for your patience.
